cases.name: Susan E. Petterson
cases.dateDetail: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; DATE OF DEATH
cases.about: Her obituary said, "At the time of her passing, Sue was a cashier, though her career included computer programming and IT support roles across several companies. A devoted partner and mother, Sue’s family and close friends meant everything to her. Nothing was more important to her than caring for her loved ones, whether through her thoughtful conversations, acts of kindness, hospitality, or feeding people the delicious food she made that ranged from simple vegetarian dishes to elaborate creations like crown roast. Sue’s passions included cooking, baking, caring for her pets Lake and the late Libby, and connecting with nature."
cases.narrative: Detectives said he walked in to the grocery store where she worked and, without saying a word, opened fire on her. After shooting her multiple times, he fatally shot himself.
